name: kb_stats
description: Read-only KB health aggregation: totals by confidence/type, stale/flagged/superseded counts, retrieval hit_rate, promote_ratio, canonical-bible presence/drift, and optional per-symbol coverage. Never bumps use_count/last_accessed (kb_list pattern). Bible drift is visibility for the machine that owns the KB -- CI cannot see the local kb.sqlite, so there is no CI gate on it.
